actions.about: Iziyalo zesigungu esiphethe zisebenza ngaphansi kobude obunikeziwe; zihloliswa ngaphambi kokukhipha futhi zingahlolwa ubulungiswa noma nini (Art. IV §5). Ukuhamba kweziyalo:
actions.active_powers_note: — lawa andisa ubude obunikeziwe kuphela endaweni nesikhathi esishaywe isandla · Art. II §7 · CLK-03:
actions.composer_cite: izindawo zezinqubo zokukhetho, zobulungiswa, nezisishayamthetho ziyanakala ngaphandle kokunqubuzana — injini ihlola isiyalo ngaphambi kokukhipha · Art. III §2 · Art. II §7
actions.department_hint: Isiyalo singabalula umnyango olawulwa yilesi sigungu esiphethe.
actions.enabling_hint: Isixazululo esiphilayo esisebenzisa isiyalo — isinqumo sokunikeza igunya noma amandla esimo esiphuthumayo asebenzayo. Isiyalo akufanele sisebenze ngaphandle kwalokho.
actions.forming_after: . Iziyalo zikhishwa isigungu esiphethe esigcotshwe noma esikhethiwe kuphela.
actions.grants_cite: Isishayamthetho sabelana ngesinqumo; isigungu esiphethe siphathelana ngakho. Izimali azisoze zedlule ibhalansi esele, futhi zonke izimali nokukhishwa kwazo kuhlanganiswa irekhodi lokucwaninga · WF-SYS-04.
actions.intro: Iziyalo, iziphakamiso zenqubo, ocwaningo, nezimali — konke ngaphansi kwamandla anikeziwe isishayamthetho. Uhlelo luqinisekisa ubude ngaphambi kokuba okuthile kusebenze: isiyalo esingaphakathi kobude obunikeziwe siyalelewa ngaphambi kokukhishwa, nokwenqaba kwalo kuya irekhodi lomphakathi. Isiyalo sonke esikhishwe singabuyezelwa ubulungiswa.
actions.investigation_dept_hint: Shiya isikhala ocwaningweni olubanzi isigungu esiphethe.
actions.investigations_cite: Amandla ocwaningo aphelele naphalinganayo eminyakeni ebonwayo · Art. III §4 — okutholwe kuyishicilelwa irekhodi lomphakathi; igunya lokuphuma lifayila isiphakamiso, isicelo sokususa, noma ukudlulisela esishayamthethweni, noma livale ngaphandle kokuthola lutho.
actions.no_orders: Azikho iziyalo ezikhishwe — imithetho yokuqinisekisa ubude isebenza kusukela esiyalo sokuqala.
actions.no_scope_banner_title: Akukho bude obunikeziwe okukhona okwamanje — F-LEG-014.
actions.no_scope_yet: akukho bude obunikeziwe okwamanje — isinqumo sokunikeza amandla asikaqali (F-LEG-014)
actions.not_issued_note: Isiyalo asizange sisebenze; ukuzama okwenqelwe kusekhona irekhodi lomphakathi — bheka phezulu kurejista ngezansi.
actions.proposals_cite_after: samukela, lungisa, noma senqabe — iziphakamiso azidluli ibhodi · Art. III §4.
actions.rails_after: ukukhishwa — isiyalo esingaphakathi kobude obunikeziwe siyalelewa futhi asize sebenze. Ukukhetho, izikhathi zomhlanganiso, nezinkantolo azikwazi ukuphazanyiswa, ngisho nangaphansi kwamandla esimo esiphuthumayo.
actions.rails_chip: uvikelo lwencindo yezimiso zomphakathi · Art. II §7 — kuqiniswe
actions.register_cite: I-oda enqotshwe iyengezwa kurejista efanayo eyayizongena kuyo — ukunqoshwa kwalo ngokwakho kuyirekhodi lomphakathi (Art. II §2).
actions.register_title: Irejista ye-oda — ekukhiphwe nasekunqotshwe kurekhodi olulodwa
advocate_console.about_esm: Icala — amafayela anehuqwa ezimweni ezithile (izicelo ngaphambi nangaphakathi kokulalelwa, ubufakazi kurekhodi oluvulekile, imibiko kuze kube kunqunywe); ikhasi lemininingwane yecala lidlala ulandelelwano oluphelele. Isikhathi sokunamathelisa sinqanywa injini, hhayi leli khasi.
advocate_console.about_workflows: ukubhalisa ngu WF-CIV-07; wonke amafayela anikeza i- WF-JUD-03 imizuzu yecala.
advocate_console.choose_case: Khetha icala elingena kulo lolu hlobo lokufayila.
advocate_console.client_hint: Umklayenti wakho uyakugcina; isivumelwano sokugcinwa sibhalwa nefayila.
advocate_console.court_of_practice_hint: Uhlala ngaphezulu kwendawo yegunya eyodwa — khetha ukuthi uzoyijoyina inkantolo yobani. Ungabhalisa kwezinye kamuva.
advocate_console.find_case_prompt: Thola icala ukuze ulikhethe lalo fayila.
advocate_console.intro: Amafayila akho, izicelo, ubufakazi, nemibiko — konke okuthumelayo kufika kurekhodi lomphakathi lecala elingene kulo. Ukumelwa kuyilungelo lomthethosisekelo labasebenzi bakho; ukubhalisa kugcina abameli bekhuthele futhi bekhaliphile.
advocate_console.jud_exists: ikhona ku-{jurisdiction} kodwa isengu-{status} — ingamukela ukubhalisa lapho isihlalo sishicilelwe.
advocate_console.jud_none: Ayikho inkantolo eyakheke endaweni yakho yegunya okwamanje — izovela lapho isishayamthetho siyidala (F-LEG-017).
advocate_console.no_cases: Amacala owafayila egama lamaklayenti avele lapha.
advocate_console.no_cases_match: Ayikho imacala ehambisana nalokhu. Zama olunye isihloko noma inombolo yedokhethi.
advocate_console.no_judiciary_body: Ukubhalisa kommeli kuvulele noma yimuphi umhlali ohambisana nalo, kodwa inkantolo kumele ibe khona endaweni yakho yegunya kuqala — izinkantolo zakheka lapho isishayamthetho idala eyodwa (F-LEG-017).
advocate_console.no_judiciary_title: Ayikho ubulungiswa eketheni lakho lokuhambisana okwamanje.
advocate_console.no_matching_page: Ayikho imacala ehambisana nalokhu kule khasi. Zama olunye isihloko noma inombolo yedokhethi.
advocate_console.qualifications_hint: Kurekhodiwe ngokubhalisa kwakho; ikhono lommeli liwumphetho wommeli, hhayi isithiyo sokulungela kwamaklayenti akho.
advocate_console.register_gloss: Ukumela kulilungelo lomthethosisekelo lamaklayenti akho; ukubhalisa kugcina abameli bekhuthele futhi benekhono. Ukubhalisa kuvulele noma yimuphi umhlali ohambisana nalo — ukuhambisana nendawo yegunya yenkantolo yiyo kuphela imvume ehlolwayo.
advocate_console.register_to_file: Bhalisa njengummeli (F-IND-015) ukuze ufayile egama lomkhethwa.
advocate_console.residency_met_after: — ukuhambisana yiyo kuphela imvume ehlolwa ngummeli.
advocate_console.residency_not_met: Udinga ukuqinisekisa ukuhlala kuqala — sho lapho uhlala khona, bese izinkantolo zaleyo ndawo zivuleka kuwe.
advocate_console.self_rep_note: Ukuzimela awudingi ukubhaliswa — le ndima ikhona ukuze abanye bameleke ngokukholeleka, hhayi njengesithiyo sokuvimba ilungelo lakho lokuzwakala.
advocate_console.summary_placeholder: Lokhu okufayilwe kucela inkantolo ukuba yenze
advocate_console.your_cases_gloss: Amacala owafayila egama lamaklayenti, kuhlanganise namacala aphelele. Bheka ngesihloko noma inombolo yerekhodi.
case_detail.about: Ukuphila kwecala ngu WF-JUD-03; ukuhlelwa kwejuri ngu WF-JUD-04; okutholwe yinkantolo ngomthethosisekelo kuhlukana kube WF-JUD-05. Imibuzo enkulu yomthethosisekelo ithatha inkantolo yonke esikhundleni sephaneli ehlelwe ngokwezigaba (CLK-16, eqinile). Umshini wesimo seCala ubonakala phezulu.
case_detail.appeal_criminal_cite: Ukupela kwecala lobugebengu kungaqinisekisa noma kukhise isinqumo — akukaze kube nokubuyisela icala (Art. II §8).
case_detail.appeal_enbanc: Lizwakala inkantolo efanayo ihleli en banc — ayikho inkantolo engumzali.
case_detail.appeal_filing_body: Iqulu kulesi isinqumo lingapela ngokungaguquki komthetho okutholwe, noma iphutha ecaleni elenze isinqumo singasebenzi. Ukupela kuvula icala elisha enkantolweni engumzali (noma inkantolo efanayo en banc); lesi isinqumo sihlala singephelile futhi isinqumo saso sigcinwe · Art. II §8.
case_detail.appeal_reason: Iqulu lale cala kuphela elingageza lesi isinqumo.
case_detail.appellate_outcome_hint: Ezomthetho: qinisekisa, shintsha noma ubuyisele. Ezobugebengu: qinisekisa noma khise isinqumo kuphela — akukaze kube nokubuyisela icala (Art. II §8).
case_detail.chambers_body: Igumbi elilawulwa ngokungena kwama-jaji ephaneli kuphela. Amaqulu nammeli angekena.
case_detail.court_actions_cite: Inkantolo iqhubisa irekhodi yokwengeza ngokufayila ngomshini — isenzo ngasinye samukelwa kuphela esimweni lapho kuvumelekile khona ngokomthetho (umshini ungumngcele). Art. IV §4.
case_detail.criminal_flag_note: — imiphumela yobugebengu inefulegi le-double-jeopardy · Art. II §8
case_detail.deliberation_cite: Ukuxoxisana okuhlukile kuvikela ubuntu bokuzimela kwejuri yontanga · Art. IV §4
case_detail.dismiss_gloss: Kutholakala ngaphambi kokuba iphaneli ihlale phansi (ifayilwe noma yamukelwe).
case_detail.dismiss_reason_hint: Irekhodi lomphakathi libalula ukuthi kungani icala liphelile.
case_detail.dj_body: Noma isinqumo singahamba kanjani, irekhodi lomphumela linefulegi le-double-jeopardy: okusolwayo angeke aphinde aboshwe futhi ngalesi soloko same. Ifulegi linqamiselwa umshini ngesikhathi sokufayila.
case_detail.dj_title: Umphumela wobugebengu — ifulegi le-double-jeopardy lihambisana nalo
case_detail.intro: Irekhodi lomphakathi lecala elilodwa phambi kwenkantolo — konke okufayiliwe, isinqumo, nephaneli elililalelayo. Le khasi likhipha irekhodi eliphilayo nomongo ozungezile; inkantolo iqhubisa irekhodi lokwengeza ngokusebenza ngomshini, hhayi ngokushintsha isikhali.
case_detail.jury_drawn_lead: Amalungu ejuri {jurors} + {alternates} abamelele adonswe ngokuhamba kwenhlanhla ku-{pool}.
case_detail.jury_drawn_title: Ukudonswa ngokuhamba kwenhlanhla kuphothulwe — i-voir dire isiqalile
case_detail.jury_pending_body: Leli cala lobugebengu linelungelo lejuri — ijuri idonswa ngokuhamba kwenhlanhla lapho isihlalo sesigcwele (F-JDG-002). Imbewu yokukhetha ishicilelwa ku-audit chain.
case_detail.jury_room_body: Ijuri lixoxisana ngokuhlukile — akukho majaji, akukho zingxoxo, akukho uxhumano. Ukuxoxisana kuyindawo yodwa engirekhodiwe; isinqumo ngokwaso siyarekhodwa.
case_detail.jury_seed_cite: Imbewu yokukhetha ishicilelwa ku-audit chain — noma ubani angaqinisekisa ukudonswa · Art. IV §4.
case_detail.jury_unanimous_hint: Isinqumo sejuri siyarekhodwa kuphela lapho ijuri livumelana ngokuphelele.
case_detail.max_hold_hint: Incwadi yegunya lokubamba kumele ibale isikhathi esiphakeme kakhulu · Art. II §8.
case_detail.no_jury: Alikho ijuri — ijuri lihambisana necala lobugebengu elineluphawu lwe-ijuri kuphela.
case_detail.no_motions: Azikho izicelo zangaphambi kokulalelwa kwecala irekhodini.
case_detail.open_hearing_cite: Kuvula iziphikiso lapho ipaneli (nejuri noma yikuphi) isihlalo sayo · Art. IV §4.
case_detail.opinion_after: — inqubo ye-Art. IV §5 kuphela engashintsha umbhalo womthetho.
case_detail.opinion_before: Ipaneli ishicilela uvo lwayo irekhodini lomphakathi, lihambisana necala nalo lonke umthetho eluchaza. Imibono i-
case_detail.opinion_commentary_cite: Ukuphenya ngomthetho njengoba ubhalwe noma uhlelwe; inqubo ye-Art. IV §5 kuphela eshintsha umbhalo womthetho.
case_detail.opinion_strong: ukuphenya ngomthetho njengoba ubhalwe noma uhlelwe
case_detail.opinion_tracker_link: Bona ukuthi okutholwe yinkantolo kushintsha kanjani umthetho — ithereka ye-Art. IV §5 →
case_detail.panel_pending_body: Ibhodi lihleli lapho inkantolo yamukela icala futhi ihlukanise ukubandakanya kobugebengu (F-JDG-001). Amajaji anengxabano ayikhiphelwa phandle futhi ukudweba kuphindwa.
case_detail.panel_rule: Ipaneli ≥3, odd, severity-scaled · Art. IV §4 · CLK-16
case_detail.proceedings_cite: Inkantolo iqhubisa icala ngesikhathi salo — ukulawula ngamunye kuvuleka kuphela esimweni lapho isenzo simthetho; injini iqinisekisa imingcele kulo lonke ifayela. Art. IV §4.
case_detail.ruling_error: Isinqumo asikwazanga ukufayilwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
case_detail.see_as_juror: Bona lo mzuzu njengomhlali wejuri obizwe →
case_detail.send_deliberation_cite: Kuvala iziphikiso; amakamelo ombuso nekamelo lejuri ayivulekile. Ukuxoxiswana kuyindawo yodwa engirekhodwa · Art. IV §4.
case_detail.sentence_cite: Kukhishwa kuphela lapho kunokutholakala ukuthi isigebengu sinecala · Art. IV §4.
case_detail.sentence_note: Lapho kutholakala ukuthi kunecala, ipaneli ikhipha isinqumo sesigwebo (F-JDG-009); noma yikuphi ukuboshwa, ukusesha, noma ukuthathwa kwezinto okuhlobene nokusebenza kwaso kudinga incwadi yegunya lenkantolo enesizathu nesikhathi esibhalwe phansi (F-JDG-010 · Art. II §8). Izenzo zenkantolo zibonakala ngezansi.
case_detail.severity_hint: Ukuhlukaniswa kwenkantolo yikona okunquma ubukhulu bepaneli — hhayi isicelo somfayila.
case_detail.stated_reason_hint: Yonke incwadi yegunya lenkantolo kumele ibeke isizathu sayo · Art. II §8.
case_detail.verdict_cite: Isinqumo sirekhodwa ijaji elihleli epaneli yale cala — isenzo sejaji kuphela, hhayi ifomu. Isinqumo socala silock-a i-double jeopardy · Art. II §8 · Art. IV §4.
case_detail.votes_for_hint: Okusekelayo + ophikisayo kumele kube ngubukhulu bepaneli; iningi liyisinqumo.
case_docket.about_body: Umjikelezo wekesi (WF-JUD-03) uhambisa zonke izifayela kusukela esikaleni nasebudumazeni obalwa kuya ekwamukelweni, ekunikezelweni kwephaneli ngokuhlunga ukungqubuzana, ekulalelweni, nasekunqumeni. Izinselelo zomthethosisekelo ziya kumlandeli we-Art. IV §5 (WF-JUD-05); ukuhlelwa kwephaneli yejuri kuhamba njenge-WF-JUD-04. Umshini wesimo seKesi:
case_docket.case_title_placeholder: isib. Okafor v. Crown Ridge LLC
case_docket.claimed_scale_hint: Indawo yegunya lapho umthetho wekesi uvela khona.
case_docket.claimed_severity_hint: Inkantolo ishintsha ubudumazi lapho yamukela — usayizi wephaneli ulandela ukuhlukaniswa kwenkantolo, hhayi okwakho.
case_docket.confirm_residency_body: Irekhodi lemacala livulekile ukuba lifundwe. Ukufayila ikesi kuvulekile kunoma ubani ohambisana nendawo yegunya (Art. I) — qinisekisa ukuhlala kwakho ukuze uvule ukufayila.
case_docket.conflict_body: ngaphambi kokuba iphaneli imise, wonke amajaji amakhethwa ahlungwa ngokungqubuzana komuntu, kwezezimali, noma ukubandakanyeka kwangaphambilini; amajaji anengqubuzano ayisuswa bese kudonswa kabusha. Imiphumela yokuhlunga ihlanganiswa nirekhodi lekesi.
case_docket.conflict_chip: Ukunikezelwa kwephaneli ngokuhlunga ukungqubuzana · inkantolo ephelele emigibonweni enkulu yomthethosisekelo · Art. IV §4 · CLK-16
case_docket.courts_span: Amacala angezansi ahambisana nalezi zinkantolo. Vula eyodwa ukuze ufaile, noma ukuze ubone irekhodi layo eliphelele.
case_docket.docket_caption: Amacala avulekile nohlobo, inkantolo, iphaneli, ubudumazi, nesimo
case_docket.filing_cite: Ukufayila ikesi lombuso/lebobuphambi · F-IND-017 → F-JDG-001 · inkantolo ihlukanisa ukukwazi ukunquma nokubudumaza, bese inikeza iphaneli ngokuhlunga ukungqubuzana · Art. IV §4 · Art. I (Ilungelo Lokulalelwa Ngendlela Efanele)
case_docket.filing_intro_2: (umthetho waliphi indawo yegunya ophikisanayo, ukuze izinga lenkantolo elifanele lilalele) kanye
case_docket.filing_intro_3: (inkantolo eyishintsha lapho yamukela). Ungafayila wena uqobo noma ngummeli obhalisiwe.
case_docket.intro_aggregate: Wonke amacala phambi kwazo zonke izinkantolo ezindaweni zakho zegunya — kusukela emakhelweni akho kuya enkantolo yomhlaba — kurekhodi olulodwa. Lokhu ukubuka nje; ukuze ufayile, vula inkantolo ofuna yona ngezansi.
case_docket.intro_single: Wonke amacala afayilwe kule nkantolo, kusukela ezingxabanweni zomthetho zasendaweni kuya emibuzweni yomthethosisekelo yenkantolo ephelele. Noma ubani ohlala lapha (umhlali oqinisekiswe) angafayila; amaphanele anikezwa inkantolo ngokuhlunga ukungqubuzana.
case_docket.no_cases: Ayikho imacala kule rekhodi — noma ubani ohambisana nendawo yegunya angafayila (Art. I).
case_docket.no_courts: Ayikho inkantolo esungulwe ezindaweni zakho zegunya okwamanje — inkantolo yasungulwa lapho isishayamthetho sisebenza (F-LEG-017). Le rekhodi izogcwala lapho izinkantolo zivela.
case_docket.panels_cite: Amaphaneli okungenani ama-3, angalingani, ahambisana nobukhulu · inkantolo ephelele emibuzweni emikhulu yomthethosisekelo · Art. IV §4 · CLK-16
case_docket.reference_cards: Amakhadi okubhekisisa — amathuluzi okufayila avula icala ngomnyango ohlukile.
cgc_detail.about: Inkampani Yenhlalakahle Yomphakathi iphrophathi yomphakathi egcinwe ngenhlalakahle yabo bonke. Isishayamthetho siyisungula (F-LEG-019), isigaba esiphethe siyibheka, kanti iphrophathi yayo yengqondo ihlala iyeyomphakathi (Art. III §5). Ngaphandle kwalokho, ilawulwa ngendlela efanayo nenkampani eyimfihlo — futhi isebenzisa isikalo sokuzinquma esifanayo nazo zonke izibhodi (Art. III §6).
cgc_detail.charter_gloss: Isishayamthetho siyidala; isigaba esiphethe siyibheka · Art. III §5.
cgc_detail.description_hint: Chaza umsebenzi onikelwayo. Ukunikela emhlabeni wonke akukwazi ukukhutshelwa emuva.
cgc_detail.governor_hint: Ukususwa kuqondiswe kulungu lebhodi elihlala esihlalweni sale nkampani.
cgc_detail.grounds_hint: Okutholwe yinkantolo mayelana nekhono/izimiso zokuziphatha okukholelwa ukuthi kuyiqiniso — kushicilelwa lapho kufayilwa.
cgc_detail.intro: Inkampani Yenhlalakahle Yomphakathi yinkampani yomphakathi enikezwe igunya isishayamthetho ukuhlinzeka ngempahla noma izinsizakalo endaweni yegunya yayo. Yaqhudelana futhi ilawulwa ngendlela efanayo nezinkampani ezizimele — kodwa kukhona umehluko owodwa ongapheli: konke ekwakha kuyengabo bonke.
cgc_detail.ip_chip: Wonke umsebenzi ungowomphakathi wonke kusukela ngomzuzu wokwakhiwa
cgc_detail.ip_cite: Wonke umsebenzi le nkampani emkhiqiza ungowomphakathi wonke kusukela ngomzuzu wokwakhiwa — yonke indawo, phakade, futhi ngeke kushintshe · Art. III §5.
cgc_detail.no_works_body: Ayikabikho imisebenzi ebhaliswe — imithetho yomphakathi wonke isebenza lapho kwakhiwa, hhayi lapho kubhaliswa.
cgc_detail.removal_cite: Ivula ukuvota esishayamthethweni esisungulayo esidinga iningi elijwayelekile labo bonke amalungu asebenza · Art. III §5.
cgc_detail.removal_gloss_after: — ukuqasha nokuxosha, hhayi imishini yeningi elikhethekile.
cgc_detail.removal_gloss_before: Ilungu lebhodi lisuswa ngokusebenzisa isigungu esiphethe esibhekile sale nkampani: isishayamthetho esisungulayo sinquma ngokusebenzisa
cgc_detail.removal_gloss_strong: iningi elijwayelekile labo bonke amalungu asebenza
cgc_detail.removal_no_governor: Alikho ilungu lebhodi esihlalweni elingafayilwa ukususwa kwalo.
cgc_detail.removal_not_active: Le nkampani ayisebenzi — amalungu ayo ebhodi angeke asuswe.
cgc_detail.reorg_body: Isishayamthetho kuphela esingahlela kabusha, sidayise, noma siqede le nkampani yomphakathi. Imisebenzi yayo esikhona ihlala iyingowomphakathi wonke ngemva kokudayiswa.
cgc_detail.same_regulation_cite: I CGC ihambisana nemithetho efanayo nalabo bonke abalingani abayizimfihlo; ukuba ngeyomphakathi akunikiwo amalungelo akhethekile okulawulwa · Art. III §5.
co_determination.about: Abasebenzi bekhetha abamele bona ukuze babelane ezinqumweni zenhlangano yabo. Le khasi likhombisa izihlalo zabasebenzi ezidingekayo nokwakheka kwebhodi okurekhodiwe. Sebenzisa isihlola ukuze ubone ukuthi ukumeleka kushintsha kanjani lapho abasebenzi beanda.
co_determination.applies_cite: Ukumeleka kwabasebenzi kulandela isilinganiso esifanayo emabhizinisini azimele, eziNkampanini Zenhlalakahle Yomphakathi, naseminyakeni yesigungu esiphethe. Izibalo ezingezansi ziyizixazululo zebhodi ezirekhodiwe.
co_determination.chair_body: Noma yikuphi ushintsho lokwakheka — isihlalo esengeziwe ngesilinganiso, isihlalo esingenamuntu, noma ukudluliselwa — kuqhuba ukukhethwa kabusha komsihlalo ohlanganyelwe yibhodi yonke. Ibhodi isebenza kuphela lapho ukwakheka kwayo kuhambisana nesilinganiso; kuze kube yilapho ukukhethwa kwabasebenzi nokukhethwa komsihlalo ohlanganyelwe kuphothulwa, ibhodi ayikwazi ukusebenza.

constitutional_challenge.intro: Noma ubani ohlala lapha angaphikisa umthetho ovimba amalungelo abo ngokungabi nami. Lapho inkantolo ithola ukungafani, kuvuleka izindlela ezintathu zokuxazulula: isishayamthetho silungise, isishayamthetho sichithe ukuvimba ngeningi elikhethekile ngaphakathi esikhathi sokuvimba, noma — uma isikhathi siphela kungekho okwenziwe — ubulungiswa bulungise umthetho ngokuqondile. Okutholwe yinkantolo, isixazululo esincomo, isikhathi esifanele sokusebenza, nesikhathi sokuchitha ukuvimba — konke kubonakala ekhoramu lomphakathi.

executive_home.about_body: Isigungu esiphethe sinikezwa amandla ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi sikhona njengesiqalo kusukela lapho indawo yegunya isungulwa. Ukuguqulwa kube yihhovisi okhethwa ngokuqondile yiyo yedwa indlela yokuba nesigungu esiphethe esizimele, futhi kunzima ngokuhlelwile: iningi elikhethekile lasekamalungwini kanye neningi elikhethekile lezindawo zegunya zabavoti kumele bavumelane. Ikhadi lemodeli engenhla lihleza likhombise isimo sangempela sehhovisi — hhayi isithombe sokuzivocavoca.
executive_home.advisory_gloss: Ingena, ngokulandelana kwezikhundla, uma ihhovisi liba nesihlalo esingenamuntu — ukubala kwabantu, hhayi ukuqashwa, okunquma ukulandelana (ukukhipha okulandelanayo · Art. III §3).
executive_home.constituted_chip: linikezwa igunya ngokuzenzakalelayo · luguquka kuphela ngeningi elikhethekile elimbili · Art. III §2–3

Amamitha omabili axazululwa ngemisebenzi evikelekile; akukho okubalwa ohlangothini lomsebenzisi kuleli khasi.

executive_home.intro: Isigungu esiphethe yingalo yokusebenza kuhulumeni — sisebenza imithetho, siqhuba iminyango, futhi siphendula esishayamthetho esisidale. Isigungu esiphethe sonke siqala njengekomiti enikezwe igunya isishayamthetho. Iningi elikhethekile — kanye neningi elikhethekile zezindawo ezilakha khona, lapho zikhona — lingaliguqula libe ihhovisi elikhethwa ngokuqondile, kungaba yikomiti yabantu bahlanu noma ngaphezulu abalingana, noma umuntu oyedwa abanabasebenzi abane balulekile. Izikhathi zesigungu esiphethe zihlala zilingana nesikhathi sesishayamthetho.
executive_home.no_conversion: Ayikho inkundla yokuguqula irekhodini. Ukuguqula isigungu esiphethe esidatshulwe kube yihhovisi elikhethwa ngokuqondile kuwisenqumo seiningi elikhethekile elimbili — iningi elikhethekile lakamere kanye niningi elikhethekile lezindawo zegunya zomvoti, yilona ngalona libalwa ngokuzimela (Art. III §3 · Art. VII).
executive_home.no_delegation: Ayikho isinqumo sokudatshula irekhodini. Isishayamthetho sidatshula igunya lesigungu esiphethe ngesenqumo seiningi elikhethekile — amalungu ahla isihlalo sawo njengabashayemthetho (Art. III §2).
executive_home.no_departments: Ayikho iminyango ehlanganiswe okwamanje. Iminyango isungulwa isishayamthetho ngesenqumo esijwayelekile (F-LEG-016 · Art. II §9); ukuphathwa kwalo kunikezwa lesi sigungu esiphethe kulesi sinqumo.

judiciary_home.no_conversion: Alikho ukuguqulwa ekurekhodini. Uma ukuguqulwa kuvunyelwa, amajaji emva kwalokho akhethwa ngamaqembu okubalana {min} nge-STV, futhi izikhathi zobulungiswa zivunyelwana nesikhathi sokukhetho jikelele (Art. IV §3 · CLK-15 · CLK-10).
judiciary_home.no_creation: Alikho isinqumo sokudala ekurekhodini — lobu bulungiswa buyisikhala somthethosisekelo. Isishayamthetho sadala inkantolo ngesinqumo seningi elikhethekile, sithatha indlela yokukhetha kusukela esakhiweni sezindawo zegunya zomvoti (Art. IV §1–§2).
judiciary_home.nomination_cite: Izindawo zegunya zomvoti zikhetha izibalo ezilinganayo; ikomiti yobulungiswa njengesixazululo sokugcina · Art. IV §2
judiciary_home.nomination_intro: Izihlalo ze {count} zale nkantolo {s} zakhethwa ngu {mode}.
judiciary_home.nomination_intro_after: Izibalo ezilinganayo kusukela kuyo yonke indawo yegunya yomvoti ziyadingeka; lapho indawo yegunya yomvoti inqaba, ikomiti yobulungiswa likesishayamthetho linikeza ukukhethwa esikhundleni sayo.
judiciary_home.panels_cite: Iphaneli okubalana 3, engenalo ihalf, ihambisana nobunzima; inkantolo ephelele emigibizelo enkulu yomthethosisekelo · Art. IV §4 · CLK-16 — amajaji akhethwayo (uma ayiguqulwe) agijima ngamaqembu okubalana {min} · Art. IV §4 · CLK-15
judiciary_home.severity_gloss: Ukuhambisana nobunzima: lapho imiphumela iba nzima, kumele kube namajaji amaningi akhulume ngakho — iphaneli ihlezi iyona engenalo ihalf ukuze kube kungekho cala elingafinyeleli esinqumweni.
judiciary_home.sits_chip: usayizi wephaneli uyimingcele eqinile · CLK-16 · Art. IV §4
judiciary_home.supermajority_gloss: Iningi elikhethekile: izithathu zamabili zowo wonke amalungu akhonza — abalwa ngokubheka wonke amuntu ophethe isihlalo, hhayi kuphela labo abakhona (ceil(akhonzayo × 2/3) · Art. VII).
judiciary_home.term_appointed: Amajaji aqashwayo anesikhathi seminyaka {years} ({clk}); amajaji akhethwayo aguquliwe agijima ngokuhambisana nokukhetho jikelele ({civil}).
judiciary_home.term_chip: ubude bokukhethwa kwezinto zomphakathi + zobulungiswa buhamba ngokuhambisana · Art. IV §1 · Art. II §9
judiciary_home.term_citation: kumele kuhambisane nokukhethwa kwezinto zomphakathi · {clk} · {civil} · Art. IV §4; Art. II §9
judiciary_home.term_move: Ubude bokukhethwa kobulungiswa nokwezinto zomphakathi buhamba ndawonye — isinqumo likesishayamthetho esishintsha esinye sishintsha zombili. Ukuvuselelwa kuphinda inqubo yokukhetha nokuvuma (WF-JUD-07).
juror_view.draw_integrity_before: isizalo sokukhetha ngohlelo sokuhlelwa sishayelwa ku-
juror_view.heading: Isimemo sejuri — {title}
juror_view.intro: Udwebwe ngohlelo lokuhlelwa phakathi kwabalungileyo basebenzi abahlali abaqinisekisiwe. Ukukhonza kuyisibopho somphakathi esivikelekile — akekho ongakuphazamisa, futhi akukho okungakubiza imali.
juror_view.no_fees_body: Akukho khokho, imali, noma isohlasho esingadingeka kuwe ukuze usebenzise ilungelo lomphakathi noma ugcwalise lesi sibopho — ukuya, ukufayila, nokuqinisekisa akukubizi lutho.
juror_view.no_interference_body: Umqashi wakho akakwazi ukukujezisa, ukukukhipha, noma ukukuvimba ngokukhonza; akekho — ohulumeni noma omakhelwane — ongaphazamisa isibopho somphakathi.
juror_view.protected_gloss: Art. II §8 wuhlu lomthethosisekelo lwezenzo ezinqandwe ezishayamthethweni — lezi zinhlelo ezimbili zivikela amalungu ejuri ekuphezu kokuphephiseka nokuboniswa amacala.
juror_view.room_body: Igumbi lokuxoxisana linokulawulwa kokungena: amalungu ejuri kuphela. Ijuri lixoxisana ngokuhlukile egumbini labajaji, ngaphandle kokuxhumana namacala, abameli, noma abajaji. Ukuxoxisana kuyindawo yodwa engirekhodwa ekulahlweni kwecala — isinqumo ngokwaso siyirekhodi.
juror_view.room_locked: Kukhiyiwe — kuvulwa lapho icala lifika ekuxoxisaneni
org_detail.about: Leli phrofayili lirekhodi lomphakathi. Ukubuyisana kokusekela, izindlela zokuhlanganisa amalungu nabasebenzi, kanye nesikala sokuzinquma ngokuhlanganyela konke kuhamba ngemodeli eyodwa yenhlangano — ayikho ingxenye yamaqembu.
org_detail.agent_gloss: Dlulisela amandla kunoma yimuphi umuntu obhaliswe. Ukudluliselwa kwenzeka khona manje futhi kunye — lowo muntu uba umelele khona manje, futhi wena ulahlekelwa ukulawula le nhlangano.
org_detail.apply_join_gloss: Faka isicelo sokujoyina le nhlangano. Ubulungu buqala lapho isicelo sakho samukeleka ngaphansi kwemithetho yayo.
org_detail.confirm_residency_join: Qinisekisa ukuhlala kwakho ukuze ujoyine (Art. I).
org_detail.confirm_residency_worker: Qinisekisa ukuhlala kwakho ukuze ubhalise njengosebenzi (Art. I).
org_detail.contracts_note: Ikontrakthi isebenza kuphela ngezibona zombili — injini ayikuvumi ukusebenza ngaphambi kokuba kube khona zombili.
org_detail.currently_unset: Njengamanje akukho okubekwe — isikhathi esivamise ukusetshenziswa sendawo yegunya siyasebenza.
org_detail.delegation_gloss: Vumela umuntu ukuba aphathe uhlobo olulodwa lomsebenzi kule nhlangano. Umele usebenza kuphela ngaphansi komsebenzi omvumele futhi akanasikhundla somthethosisekelo. I-agency uqobo lwayo, ukunikeza igunya, nokunqamuka akukaze kunikezwe omunye. Khansela noma yikuphi igunya noma nini.
org_detail.delegation_search_hint: Funa umuntu esigabeni se- "Umele (i-agent)" phezulu, bese ukhetha lowo lapha.
org_detail.documents_note: Amaphakheji angaphakathi awashintshi amafomu omthethosisekelo — ikhi lephakheji akufanele lihlangane ne-ID yefomu.
org_detail.endorsements_gloss: Omkhethwa bangacela ukusekelwa yile nhlangano. Umele wayo ubuyekeza izicelo, kanti ukusekelwa okugunyazwe kuba irekhodi lomphakathi.
org_detail.err_decision: Isinqumo asikwazanga ukufayilwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
org_detail.err_delegation: Ukudela igunya asikwazanga ukufayilwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
org_detail.err_reendorse: Ukuphinda ukusekelwa asikwazanga ukufayilwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
org_detail.err_revoke: Ukubuyisela emuva asikwazanga ukufayilwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
org_detail.err_search: Ukusesha asikwazanga ukulandwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
org_detail.err_transfer: Ukudlulisela asikwazanga ukufayilwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
org_detail.err_withdraw: Ukuhoxeka asikwazanga ukufayilwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
org_detail.f_contract_ref_hint: Isivumelwano somsebenzi esiphindaphindayo sisekela ukubhalisa; sibalwa ekubaleni kwabantu lapho inhlangano isayina.
org_detail.f_nomination_window: Vula isikhathi sokupheka (izinsuku ngaphambi kokuba ukuhlelwa kuqale)
org_detail.intro: Yazi ngale nhlangano, thola imisebenzi yayo, noma joyina imisebenzi yayo.
org_detail.job_board_gloss: Hlola izikhundla ezivulekile zale nhlangano futhi ufake isicelo somsebenzi. Inhlangano ibuyekeza izicelo.
org_detail.membership_apps_gloss: Buyekeza abantu abafake isicelo sokujoyina. Ukwamukela kunikeza ubulungu; ukwenqaba kugcina isicelo, kanti lowo muntu angaphinda afake isicelo.
org_detail.no_roles: Azikho izikhundla ezivulekile njengamanje — izikhangiso zizovela lapha lapho inhlangano ivula eyodwa.
org_detail.nomination_gloss_1: Isikhathi esithatha isigaba sokuphetha kokukhetha ibhodi ngaphambi kokuba ukuhlelwa kuqale.
org_detail.nomination_gloss_2: Umtalelwane wenhlangano mayelana nayo yona — uqashwe irekhodi lokucwaninga, hhayi njengoxazululo lomthethosisekelo.
org_detail.transfer_to_after: . Lokhu kusebenza khona manje futhi ngeke ukukwazi ukukuhoxisa kamuva.
org_detail.worker_citation: abasebenzi ababhalisiwe babalwa ekumelweni kwabasebenzi benhlangano.
registry.about: Noma yiphi ubuntu noma inhlangano ingasekela umkhethwa. Izinhlobo zezinhlangano aziniki amalungelo akhethekile okukhetho. Vula inhlangano ukuze ubone ibhodi yayo, izimali kanye nezinketho zobulungu.
registry.cgc_note: Izinkampani Zenhlalakahle Yomphakathi azizibhalisi zodwa — isishayamthetho sizidala ngesinqumo ngaphansi kwenkqubo yokudala izinsizakalo zomphakathi.
registry.confirm_residency_body: Ukubhalisa kulungelo olungenakuphikiswa lwanoma yimuphi umhlali ohambisana nalokhu (Art. I, Inkululeko Yezomnotho) — kumele ube nohlangano lokuhlala olusebenzayo kuqala.
registry.intro: Thola inhlangano, ubuyekeze umsebenzi wayo, noma uqale eyodwa. Bheka emhlabeni wonke noma unciphise uhlu uye endaweni ethile.
registry.no_match_body: Zama omunye uqalo wegama noma ususe ifiltha.
registry.start_org_hint: Khetha 'informal' eklabhu. Izinhlobo zezinhlangano ezihlukile zingashono indlela yokuba ngumnikazi.
transfers_conversions.about: Izindlela ezine, omunye umongo: ubumnikazi abukaze bushintshe ngokungafuni komnikazi ngaphandle lapho umthethosisekelo ubhala inzalo yomphakathi (imonopoli), ngisho nalapho kukhokhelwa inani elifanele lemakethe. Ukuguqulwa kokuba ngomphakathi↔okuba ngomuntu siqala esishayamthethweni; i-IP yomphakathi ihlala iyomphakathi unomphela (Art. III §5).

transfers_conversions.intro: Umnikazi wenhlangano angashintsha ngezindlela ezinhlanu, kanti le khasi likhombisa zonke zinhlanu: ithengiswa ngokuvumelana, ithathwe isishayamthetho lapho kutholakala i-monopoly, iguqulwe phakathi komphakathi nokuyimfihlo, ihlelwe kabusha ezandleni ezimfihlo, noma ivalwe. Indlela ye-monopoly kuphela eyichitha imvume yabanikazi — futhi inezinkokhelo eziqinisekisiwe.
transfers_conversions.no_restructurings: Akukho kuhlelwa kabusha kwangaphakathi okurekhodiwe lapha — umlando wesakhiwo ubonakala ephandle lokumnikazi wenhlangano ngayinye.
transfers_conversions.restructure_gloss: Umngcele wokuvuma uvela emithethweni yakhona yesakhiwo samanje — ubuhlobo obulinganayo budinga ukuvuma kwabo bonke; isakhiwo sesitoko sibala amasheya okuvota. Ukuhlose kubhalisa ukuvuma kwakho. Abanalo itshala kuphela abasebenza; injini yenqaba omunye noma ubani, isinikeze isizathu.
transfers_conversions.restructuring_body: Ukuhlela kabusha ngaphakathi akudingi isishayamthetho — ukuvuma komnikazi ngokwemithetho yesakhiwo samanje (ukushintsha kobuhlobo, isibonelo, kudinga ukuvuma kwabo bonke abahlobo). Umlando wesakhiwo ugcinwe irekhodi lomphakathi.
transfers_conversions.transfer_body_afte: , WF-ORG-06): umnikazi wamanje uqala bese odluliselwa kuvuma. Kokubili kumele kube irekhodi; injini yenqaba ukuqedela kune lokhu.
